note: Sector definitions for the map generator (S3.1, D-104). A sector is a band of space crossed from an origin port on the left to a delivery port on the right, in columns. `nodes` is the range of points on the chart, `columns` the range of columns they sit in (origin and delivery are columns of their own). `kinds` weights what each point in between is; `minimum` makes sure each kind turns up at least that often. `hazards` are the names a hazard point is given. `designations` are the letter codes on Margo's company chart. `pursuit` is the chance a run's contract is followed, which encounter follows (content/encounters/; it turns up on the scope closing when it catches us, H.3), how many jumps late it sets out, and how far away Margo can see it. `events` is the chance that arriving at each kind of point for the first time brings a transit event (S3.3; ports open the port instead). `contacts` is the chance that arriving at each kind of point puts a ship on the scope (H.1, D-151): which one is drawn from content/encounters/ by each encounter's `at` and `weight`. Port names stay as chart designations until ports become content in S3.4 and S3.5 (DF-47).
